assessment: Fresh derivation supports the tested data model and normative placement contracts without new source fields or proposal changes. This is bounded evidence, not full conformance.

clarification.classification: Registration/integration detail, not an unresolved placement rule
clarification.finding: The publishing profile predecessor graph is unspecified. Labeled graphs change generic IsCompatibleWith results; empty qualified capability usage remains known-none under the proposal, even when this SDK generic query returns NoPath.
clarification.recommendation: State that discovery reads qualified composed usage metadata, not generic compatibility status; supply the predecessor graph with registration and keep namespace review explicit.

prototype_limits: General nonlinear derivative/vector/normal transport is not certified; unsupported requests fail.
Continuous surface/time bounds are not certified by finite vertices or samples.
Occurrence exporter refuses authored instance normals; material-graph closure is not claimed.
Full native-format coverage, conditional/nested variant publisher enumeration and formal ISO WKT grammar conformance are not established.
Native format decoder and PROJ are shared dependencies; the placement readers are independently written in Python and C++.
resolved_implementation_findings: OGC-preferred WKT aliases initially chosen incorrectly; fixed from referenced productions.
Native grid-backed operations loaded an incompatible SDK PROJ library; pinned the TIFF-capable loader path.
Stale PROJ errors from probing missing alternate grids were mistaken for actual operation failures; reset immediately before transform.
Exporter retained unrequested point samples; clear and author only selected samples.
Native tuples could fill missing height with zero; enforce domain dimensions.
Malformed or soft geospatial usage could qualify as known-none; retain conservative unknown.
Native compound geographic/vertical CRS was classified as Cartesian; inspect its horizontal coordinate system before applying the specified working chart. Regression now agrees within 5 nanometres.
Time-dependent operations escaped Python deferral because PROJ emitted bare parameter names; parse both string forms and reject missing-epoch operations.
Legacy GeoJSON CRS identifiers were substring-matched; require recognized complete spellings.
Enclosing working binding role was not validated; reject non-Xformable bindings.
A model path shortcut through associated geocentric CRS bypassed an authored BOUNDCRS operation; route through the complete source CRS and test an analytic static shift.
Instance query receipts omitted authored IDs; retain ID/index and full prototype context.
data_intake_findings: Original climate file lacks CF role/unit/grid mapping metadata; reject it.
Original railway third coordinate lacks established vertical reference; horizontal derivative explicitly drops it, original preserved.
Eiffel asset cm metadata conflicts with producer-known metre geometry; explicit ordinary writer conformance is labeled.
